messages:
nate: FYI onboarding run for 'sablev1-int4' shows unexpected field duplication inside tool args under heavy batching. parse failure ~2.3% across the canary.

kevin: paste one.

aisha: example: {
  "id": "abc",
  "actions": [
    {"name": "scan", "args": {"path": ["/tmp", "/tmp"]}}
  ]
}

nate: args.path sometimes duplicated or contains partial copies e.g., ["/t","mp"]. looks like stream chunk boundaries concatenated incorrectly.

kevin: int4 quant often shifts token boundaries. Could we be splitting utf-8 tokens mid-surface? check tokenizer boundaries.

aisha: local trace shows chunker cuts at 64-token frames and doesn't guarantee utf-8 or JSON token alignments. Runtime stitches bytes, but our parser does a naive JSON decode on reconstructed text which can produce duplicates if chunks overlap.

nate: short-term: change parser to run a robust JSON recovery that dedups identical adjacent array elements if they appear to be split duplicates. Longer-term: enforce chunk alignment at tokenizer whitespace boundaries for JSON outputs.

kevin: also check if our streaming joiner is dropping separators between frames. That would explain cases like ["/t","mp"].

ci-bot: queued job 90422: token-boundary-onboard-check for sablev1-int4.

aisha: opened infra ticket INF-1123 to add per-frame checksum and ordering metadata to avoid overlap.

nate: will add postproc heuristics and run a 20k sample test to see if duplication rate drops.

kevin: good. add to onboarding doc: "verify tokenizer-safe chunk boundaries for structured outputs".

nate: will report back with numbers.
